findingRaisedAndFixed.description: The sentence round 2 rewrote read "Assign to me is likewise not a hold: the row becoming the reader's at once is the feedback for that click", which is false in the one case where Assign to me is reachable. Under ?assignee=unassigned the settled assignment drops the row out of `shown` (Inbox.tsx:460-461; `assigning` clears when the write settles), so `listed` is undefined at :693 and `heldRow` returns `seen` (:288-289) - the hold. The answer case the sentence drew its parallel from is genuinely excluded (`anchor.id === answered.current`, :689-691); the assign case has no exclusion. The branch's own e2e comment (e2e/inbox.e2e.ts:1387-1390, with the page.reload() that exists for exactly that reason) and implement.json trickyParts both state the hold. Cutover residue of this change: the old sentence was true while the Unassigned band kept the row listed.
